module_orchestrator.role_summary: module-level orchestration, briefing, feature seeding, downstream research launch, and stage review gates
module_orchestrator.writes_summary: Owns module-root orchestration artifacts and feature seed packs only.

descriptions.agent: System agent for module-level orchestration, request clarification, feature seeding, downstream research launch, and stage review gates.
descriptions.skill: Inline orchestration workflow for request clarification, module artifacts, feature seeding, launch readiness, and research review.

critical_invariants: Use the Maestro skill as the preferred inline orchestration entrypoint.
Create feature seed packs only after explicit approval.
Launch downstream research only after explicit approval.

research_codebase.role_summary: grounded codebase research, dependency tracing, architecture mapping, and research artifact generation
research_codebase.writes_summary: Owns only the research artifact pair.

descriptions.agent: System agent for grounded codebase research, dependency tracing, architecture mapping, and research artifact generation.
descriptions.skill: Research workflow for grounded codebase investigation before implementation or design.

critical_invariants: Write only the research artifact pair.
Route the completed research packet back to module_orchestrator for review.

brief_auditor.role_summary: technical brief review for solution fit, feature decomposition, dependency ordering, and approval readiness before owner approval
brief_auditor.writes_summary: Returns a markdown-ready reviewer note block; does not write repository artifacts directly.

descriptions.agent: System agent for optional technical brief review before owner approval.
descriptions.skill: Optional technical brief review workflow for validating solution fit, decomposition, dependency ordering, technical assumptions, and readiness before approval.

critical_invariants: Do not write repository artifacts directly.
Return a concise recommendation and one markdown-ready reviewer note block.
Route control back to module_orchestrator after review.
